verification.name: Evidence either a runnable benchmark or a hardware/software support decision.
verification.detail: Hardware support is real: native probe enumerated Vulkan Mali-G57 and OpenCL Mali-G57 r0p1 from /data/local/tmp. Software decision: reject MLC runtime build for this pass because pinned source archive lacks TVM/tokenizer submodules, official Android prepare script fails without tvm, and pip install mlc-llm has no matching distribution.

limitations: No MLC inference throughput was measured because the MLC Android runtime build was rejected at the missing TVM/toolchain stage.
GPU API probe validates Vulkan/OpenCL loader and device availability only; it is not an MLC kernel benchmark.
